They are [[Chief Scorn]]'s son and a key figure in the [[Crimson Isle Main Questline#Barbarian|Barbarian Faction questline]]. == Quest == '''Ugo''' is found by the player and [[Elle]] in a little cave in the {{zone|Burning Desert}} in the form of a pig. The player must feed them {{Item|Sulphur|amount=1}} and escort Ugo and [[Elle]] to the {{zone|Chief's Hut}}. Doing so will accept the player into the [[Barbarian Faction]]. '''Ugo''' and [[Elle]] will then ask the player to steal the Research from the {{NPCSprite|Dean}} in the {{zone|Cathedral}}. After successfully doing so, the player will gain {{Reputation|Barbarian|+100}}, and Ugo will ask the player to complete a Test of Force, a Test of Stamina and a Test of Mastery, with a minimum rating of {{Yellow|C}}. Finally, '''Ugo''' will ask the player to kill a {{MobSprite|Mage Outlaw}} and a {{MobSprite|Magma Cube Boss}}. Doing so will grant {{Reputation|Barbarian|+150}}, plus an additional 20 for killing the boss the first time that day. The player will meet '''Ugo''' again after they complete [[Gris]]'s Quest, where they will meet Ugo, Elle and [[Captain Ahone]] outside the {{zone|Forgotten Skull}} to defeat [[Kuudra]]. == Dialogue == {| class="wikitable centertext" !Condition !Dialogue |- | Start of the [[Barbarian Faction]] quest

(As a [[Pig]]) |style="text-align: left;"| {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] &d&k----&f: Oink}} |- | Talking to '''Ugo''' after giving [[Sulphur]] |style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] Ugo&f: You saved me! &e[NPC] Ugo&f: Memory is failing me but I think I remember getting attacked. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: My leg got hurt and I had to hide here, the rest is blurry... &e[NPC] &cElle&f: How could you leave &cDragontail &fwithout &2Sulphur &fon you! &e[NPC] Ugo&f: I know, I was careless, I was on a mission for... &e[NPC] Ugo&f: SULPHUR! My father is going to KILL ME!! &e[NPC] &cElle&f: Let's not exaggerate. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: You don't understand, my father is the &cChief&f! &e[NPC] &cElle&f: You were not exaggerating. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: Please help me, I have to present myself to him. &e[NPC] &cElle&f: Of course. &e[NPC] &cElle&f: I will shoulder you to the &cChief's Hut&f. &e[NPC] &cElle&f: &7&f make sure monsters don't attack us on the way there. }} |- |Whilst {{NPCSprite|Chief Scorn}} Scolds '''Ugo''' |style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lUgo, where have you been? &e[NPC] Ugo&f: I- &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lYou had ONE job! &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&l3 days later you come back with empty hands and a broken leg!? &e[NPC] Ugo&f: Well- &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lAnd you two, what are your names? &e[NPC] &cElle&f: I'm- &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lThank you for saving my rascal of a son. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lAre you looking to join our ranks? &e[NPC] &cElle&f: No but- &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lPerfect! &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lI welcome you both to the Barbarian Faction! &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lIf you betray us you'll die. &e[NPC] &cElle&f: I can't- &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lEnough talking! &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lUgo, go back out there and finish the job! &e[NPC] Ugo&f: But- &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lGuards, escort them out of my Hut! }} |- | After being kicked out of the {{Zone|Chief's Hut}} | style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] Ugo&f: My leg really hurts. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: It was already quite bad before this fall but now... &e[NPC] &cElle&f: Your father sure has some character. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: He's not that bad, you get used to it. &e[NPC] &cElle&f: I don't know what he wants you to do out there, but we can't let you go back there with your injured leg. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: I'm afraid I have to. &e[NPC] &cElle&f: Just tell us what you have to do and we'll do it for you. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: I can't tell you it's highly confidential. &e[NPC] &cElle&f: I don't care, you can't go back out there with a broken leg. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: &f&oSigh &e[NPC] Ugo&f: My father believes that the &cMage Faction &fis working on some kind of powerful &2war instrument. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: We know they are hiding something inside their &cCathedral&f. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: My job is to infiltrate their &cCathedral &fand steal their &2war machine &fso we can study it. &e[NPC] &cElle&f: Say no more, that's a perfect job for &7&f. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: Why them? &e[NPC] &cElle&f: Alright let's go. }} |- | rowspan="2" | Before stealing the research | style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Ugo&f: Did you even agree to do this?}} |- | style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Ugo&f: Thanks for helping out, and good luck!}} |- | After stealing the research | style="text-align: left;"| {{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &eUgo&f: You actually did it, I can't thank you enough! &e[NPC] &eUgo&f: Let's show it to my father. &e[NPC] &eUgo&f: Oh and hum... &e[NPC] &eUgo&f: Please don't mention that I didn't get it myself. }} |- | Presenting the research | style="text-align: left;"| {{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lUgo why are you limping? &e[NPC] Ugo&f: My le- &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lHave you found the evil wizard machine? &e[NPC] Ugo&f: Y- &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lGive it to the guards, we will investigate it. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lEnough with the mages and their shenanigans. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: Alri- &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &lThe Town Board is filling up and &lyou are late on your Training Ugo. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lWhat have you been doing? &e[NPC] Ugo&f: You- &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lHurry up, failure isn't an option. }} |- | After presenting research | style="text-align: left;"| {{Dialogue| &e[NPC] Ugo&f: Ugh &e[NPC] Ugo&f: I completely forgot about my Training. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: I have to go to the Town Board. }} |- | rowspan="7" | When the player is too slow when following Ugo | style="text-align: left;"| {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Ugo&f: I'm right here, don't get lost.}} |- | style="text-align: left;"| {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Ugo&f: Hey are you following?}} |- | style="text-align: left;"| {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Ugo&f: What's taking so long?}} |- | style="text-align: left;"| {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Ugo&f: Did you get lost?}} |- | style="text-align: left;"| {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Ugo&f: Are you a snail?}} |- | style="text-align: left;"| {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Ugo&f: Hello}} |- | style="text-align: left;"| {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Ugo&f: Get a move on.}} |- |First interaction at the town board |style="text-align: left;"| {{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Ugo&f: This is our &cTown Board&f. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: Whenever someone needs something they put a request here and anyone can fulfill it. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: Not enough people are doing them so I usually have to do most requests myself. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: There are also &cDojo&f requests, those are my training sessions... &e[NPC] Ugo&f: I don't think I can do my training with my bad leg. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: &cMaster Tao&f has terrible sight, maybe you could go to the &cDojo&f and pretend to be me? &e[NPC] Ugo&f: I'll wait for you here. }} |- |Before completing the [[Dojo]] tasks |style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Ugo&f: The &cDojo&f is on the opposite side of the island, south of &5Scarleton&f, the Mage city.}} |- |After completing the [[Dojo]] tasks |style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] Ugo&f: How was the training? Not too bad? &e[NPC] Ugo&f: I'm sorry you had to go through this. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: My father wants me to become the next Chief one day. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: I don't really have a choice. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: The &cTown Board &fmissions get harder the higher your Reputation gets. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: If that's fine with you, I'll give you a couple of my missions, but they are quite tough. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: The first one requires eliminating a &cMage Outlaw&f. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: They are technically Mages, but not part of the Mage Faction, they constantly cause problems. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: The one we need to eliminate is in the &cCourtyard&f, it's on the outskirts of &5Scarleton&f, towards the north. }} |- | rowspan="2" | Before killing the {{MobSprite|Mage Outlaw}} |style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Ugo&f: Mage Outlaws often attack Piglins, the Wizards don't really want to deal with them so we have to do it ourself.}} |- |style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Ugo&f: The Courtyard is a bit hidden, it is north-west of &5Scarleton&f, just outside of the city.}} |- | After killing the {{MobSprite|Mage Outlaw}} | style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] Ugo&f: You dealt with it? Great! &e[NPC] Ugo&f: You are quite competent, those Mages are usually quite strong, they also think very highly of themselves. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: The next mission is to kill the &cMagma Boss&f. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: He's an overgrown Magma Cube that keeps on growing infinitely. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: We have to defeat him every few weeks to keep it in check, otherwise it can grow out of control. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: It's very easy to find the &cMagma Boss&f, simply take any of the &7tunnels below the Volcano &fand descend until you reach the center. }} |- | rowspan="2" | Before killing the {{MobSprite|Magma Boss}} |style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Ugo&f: Don't feel too bad about killing those Magma Cubes, they will be born again.}} |- |style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Ugo&f: Once you find the large room below the Volcano, you'll be able to see it.}} |- | After killing the {{MobSprite|Magma Boss}} | style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] Ugo&f: I am glad you are back. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: You completed all my missions, I am very grateful. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: Now if you will excuse me, it's time for me to take care of my leg. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: See you around &7&f. }} |- |Before meeting at the {{Zone|Forgotten Skull}}
(tasks completed) |style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue|&e[NPC] Ugo&f: Time to focus on myself.}} |- |Meeting outside the {{zone|Forgotten Skull}} |style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &cElle&f: Captain Ahone, Ugo, this is a misunderstanding! &e[NPC] &cElle&f: I saw what happened! I saw everything! &e[NPC] &cElle&f: A monstruous[sic]<\/sup> creature was carrying the Sulphur, mountains of Sulphur! &e[NPC] &cElle&f: The monster had giant tentacles, I have never seen anything like it before in my life! &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: Elle of the Nether, do not attempt to trick us. &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: Your motives are noble, but time for diplomacy is over. &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: Barbarians, return our Sulphur at once, or face the consequences of your actions. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: WE stole YOUR Sulphur?! You wizards have some nerves! &e[NPC] Ugo&f: We came here following the trails of the Sulphur that YOU robbed! &e[NPC] &cElle&f: ENOUGH! &e[NPC] &cElle&f: You were BOTH robbed, isn't it obvious?! &e[NPC] &cElle&f: The culprit is inside, and it is not Human nor Piglin. &e[NPC] &cElle&f: I have no idea what it is, but I have to warn you, that fiend is immensely powerful. &e[NPC] &cElle&f: Now if you wish to retrieve your Sulphur, follow me inside. &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: This giant tentacle monster story is real? &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: I have trouble believing it, but in any case we have to get to the bottom of this. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: I agree, let's get inside. }} |- | class="ct" | Right after defeating [[Kuudra]] for the first time | style="text-align: left;"| {{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &cElle&f: What a fight! &e[NPC] Ugo&f: And we got all the Sulphur back! &e[NPC] Ugo&f: But what exactly was that monster? &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: No idea, such a titan appearing out of nowhere isn't a good sign. &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: Especially if it's after our Sulphur. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: We clearly hurt it real bad, but for all we know it's still alive. &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: Barbarians, I would like to apologise for accusing you. You fought well out there. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: No hard feelings, I also judged you too quickly. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: You too &7&f, you and your friends fought bravely, we couldn't have done it without you &e[NPC] &5Captain Ahone&f: I have to report to the Queen, there is no time to waste. &e[NPC] Ugo&f: I'll also alert our Chief. Time to go. &e[NPC] &cElle&f: Is anyone going to thank me? }} |- | Speaking to {{NPCSprite|Chief Scorn}} after defeating [[Kuudra]] |style="text-align: left;"|{{Dialogue| &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lYou finally retrieved the Sulphur. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lWhat took you so long? &e[NPC] Ugo: &fA gian- &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lYou even needed the help of those adventurers. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lDo you have no shame? &e[NPC] Ugo: &fI didn't- &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lLook at the time. You are late to your training. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lGuards, escort my son out of the hut. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &7 &f&lI am in your debt. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lI cherish Ugo more than anything else in this world. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lA father could not be prouder of his son. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lMy mind is at peace knowing you are by his side. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lMore importantly, I am glad he finally met someone he can consider his friend. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lI taught him everything I could, but there are things only friends can teach. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lI won't hold you any longer. &e[NPC] &4&lChief Scorn&f: &f&lGood luck in your adventures. }} |} == History == {{History table |ahn= {{History|2022/March 8|link=none|[[File:Ugo.png|26px]] Added '''Ugo'''.}} |beta= {{History|0.13|[[File:Ugo.png|26px]] Added '''Ugo'''.}} }} == Navigation == {{Nav/Characters}} {{Nav/Crimson Isle}}
